subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should this issue remain the broad tracker for Control UI zh-CN tab interiors while maintainers sequence the focused open PRs, or should it be narrowed or superseded by another localization tracker?
rationale: Current main still has source-reproducible English UI copy, but remaining work spans overlapping PRs plus translation-scope choices that automation should not resolve unilaterally.

options.title: Keep Broad UI Tracker
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring PRs to follow the generated i18n pipeline.

options.title: Narrow To Original Tabs
options.body: Limit this issue to Agents, Skills, Channels, Sessions, Nodes, and Debug, and route Settings, chat metadata, docs, CLI, and runtime localization to linked issues.

options.title: Supersede Into Localization Epic
options.body: Move remaining work to a broader localization issue only after selecting one canonical tracker and preserving these tab-specific findings.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad UI Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring PRs to follow the generated i18n pipeline.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is about product scope and sequencing across Control UI/i18n work, and steipete has recent adjacent UI/i18n history plus related maintainer-routing signals.
